summary: Dogs are social companion animals that usually need regular exercise, training, and human interaction.
idealFor: Families, active owners, and people who want a highly interactive pet

breeds.name: Golden Retriever
breeds.goodFor: Families with children and owners who can provide daily activity
breeds.highlights: Golden Retrievers are known for their trainability, calm nature, and reliable family temperament.

breeds.name: German Shepherd
breeds.goodFor: Experienced owners who want a smart, active, and protective dog
breeds.highlights: German Shepherds are highly trainable and thrive with structure, exercise, and mental engagement.

breeds.name: Beagle
breeds.goodFor: Homes that enjoy playful dogs and can manage scent-driven curiosity
breeds.highlights: Beagles are cheerful, compact hounds that usually do best with regular walks and enrichment.

breeds.name: Poodle
breeds.goodFor: Owners who want a bright, trainable dog and can maintain coat care
breeds.highlights: Poodles are intelligent and adaptable, but their coat needs regular brushing and grooming.

summary: Cats are independent but affectionate companions that need stable routines, safe spaces, and environmental enrichment.
idealFor: Apartment homes, quieter households, and people who prefer a lower-maintenance companion

breeds.name: Persian
breeds.goodFor: Calm homes that can handle frequent coat and eye care
breeds.highlights: Persian cats are gentle indoor companions, but they need consistent grooming and a clean environment.

breeds.name: Maine Coon
breeds.goodFor: Families wanting a social cat with a larger build and playful nature
breeds.highlights: Maine Coons are often easygoing and social, with long coats that benefit from regular brushing.

breeds.name: British Shorthair
breeds.goodFor: Owners looking for a balanced indoor cat with a calm routine
breeds.highlights: British Shorthairs are sturdy, calm cats that are usually easy to manage in indoor homes.

breeds.name: Siamese
breeds.goodFor: Homes that want an interactive cat and can give regular attention
breeds.highlights: Siamese cats are expressive, people-oriented, and often prefer regular companionship.

summary: Pet birds need clean cages, mental stimulation, safe handling, and species-appropriate social interaction.
idealFor: Owners who enjoy observation, daily cage care, and vocal or social companion pets

breeds.name: Budgerigar
breeds.goodFor: Beginners who want a smaller companion bird with daily interaction
breeds.highlights: Budgies are popular starter birds and benefit from social contact, toys, and gentle handling.

breeds.name: Cockatiel
breeds.goodFor: Homes wanting a friendly bird that bonds with human caretakers
breeds.highlights: Cockatiels are affectionate birds that often enjoy routine interaction and quiet training.

breeds.name: Lovebird
breeds.goodFor: Owners who can provide regular social attention and enrichment
breeds.highlights: Lovebirds are active and engaging, but they can become stressed without enough stimulation.

breeds.name: African Grey Parrot
breeds.goodFor: Experienced bird owners ready for a long-term, mentally demanding companion
breeds.highlights: African Greys are brilliant parrots that need extensive mental stimulation and stable care routines.

summary: Rabbits are sensitive prey animals that need gentle handling, hay-based diets, and safe indoor spaces.
idealFor: Quiet homes that can provide safe enclosure space and patient handling

breeds.name: Holland Lop
breeds.goodFor: Families wanting a small indoor rabbit with daily gentle interaction
breeds.highlights: Holland Lops are compact and friendly, but still need space to move and a proper hay-based diet.

breeds.name: Mini Rex
breeds.goodFor: Homes that want a rabbit with a shorter coat and steady temperament
breeds.highlights: Mini Rex rabbits are known for their soft coat and manageable grooming needs.

breeds.name: Lionhead
breeds.goodFor: Owners who like an expressive rabbit and can maintain coat care
breeds.highlights: Lionheads have a distinctive mane and benefit from regular brushing around the face and neck.

breeds.name: Flemish Giant
breeds.goodFor: Owners with enough space for a large rabbit and careful handling routines
breeds.highlights: Flemish Giants are impressive in size and need larger housing, larger litter setups, and careful lifting.

summary: Aquarium pets need stable water conditions, species-compatible tank mates, and consistent maintenance.
idealFor: People who enjoy low-handling pets and can maintain a clean, stable tank system

breeds.name: Betta
breeds.goodFor: Smaller aquariums with proper heating and owners who want a single-feature fish
breeds.highlights: Bettas are beautiful but still need heated, filtered water and should not be treated as bowl pets.

breeds.name: Goldfish
breeds.goodFor: Owners willing to provide larger tanks and regular water maintenance
breeds.highlights: Goldfish create significant waste, so they need more tank space and filtration than many people expect.

breeds.name: Guppy
breeds.goodFor: Beginners building peaceful community tanks
breeds.highlights: Guppies are colorful and adaptable, but they reproduce quickly and need stable water quality.

breeds.name: Angelfish
breeds.goodFor: Owners with taller tanks and a little experience with community compatibility
breeds.highlights: Angelfish need calm tank conditions and enough room due to their body shape and fin size.

summary: Hamsters, guinea pigs, and similar small companions need secure habitats, clean bedding, and species-specific diets.
idealFor: Owners who want smaller pets but can still commit to habitat care and gentle handling

breeds.name: Syrian Hamster
breeds.goodFor: Owners who understand solitary housing and nighttime activity
breeds.highlights: Syrian hamsters should live alone and need wheels, tunnels, and chew toys for enrichment.

breeds.name: Dwarf Hamster
breeds.goodFor: Owners comfortable with small, fast-moving pets and secure enclosures
breeds.highlights: Dwarf hamsters are tiny and active, so enclosure safety and careful handling matter a lot.

breeds.name: Guinea Pig
breeds.goodFor: Homes that can keep them in compatible pairs and provide fresh vegetables
breeds.highlights: Guinea pigs are social animals that usually do best with companionship and steady routines.

breeds.name: Chinchilla
breeds.goodFor: Experienced owners who can provide cool environments and dust-bath care
breeds.highlights: Chinchillas are delicate small pets that need cool temperatures, jumping space, and dust baths.
